adoption_policy: Only actual-event-qualified failed-CFD residual centers updated; normal/particle functions identical to baseline. Statistical and energy-support limits stored per model.
existing_ROOT: No experiment ROOT rebuilt or relabeled; future processing uses this profile after activation.
gamma_domain_keV: 40<=E<2000; outside domain retain full inherited channel constant
high_preservation: No high-beam model adopted unless separately qualified; see failed_center_models. All other complete functions preserved.
limitations: Recenter dominant prompt modes; this does not remove broad stochastic tails or establish all energy bins at0. Single-reference/constant anchors explicitly marked.
low_native_scope: Ge40<=E<2000keV; curves return to constant outside measured support over a single adjacent transition interval. Constant-only and unknown branches labeled.
low_particle_reference: Per-channel physical particle energy and per-run/view terms from the frozen source candidate; both S3 faces included using their own validated source terms.
name: candidate
old_TW: active profile replaces legacy Ge TW; do not stack them
original_offsets: All full inherited offsets frozen in this JSON; no external old timing parameter table is read
outside_strict_runs: legacy for every run outside the173-run strict list

particle_channel_update.gauge: S3 common clock phase held through mean24ring corrections; particles alone cannot measure absolute phase.
particle_channel_update.method: Si per-period normalGe-core constants; low S3 per-period independent-face network; high S3 per-run face-network constants; existing energy slopes inherited. All shifts folded into COMPLETE pieces.
particle_channel_update.validation: Two nonoverlapping new raw segments per173runs; second segment held out from fits. No Ge functions updated.

qualification: Inherited curve qualifications remain provenance; adopted failed-center models carry their own actual-reprojection qualifications and warnings.
quantization: One calibration addition instead of two; not bitwise identical integer timestamps
s3_reference: same -P shift on every S3 ring/sector; Si unchanged; preserves front/back relative alignment
